title: Superlatives

expressions.example: This is the best coffee I've ever had — the best of all!
Her cooking is second to none in this city.
Seeing the Northern Lights was a once in a lifetime experience.
She studied the most and finished top of the class.

sentences: This is the tallest building in the city.
She is the most intelligent student in the class.
That was the best movie I have ever seen.
English is the most useful language to learn.
He is the fastest runner on the team.
This is the most expensive restaurant in town.
It was the worst day of my life.
She is the happiest person I know.

grammar.title: Superlatives — O/A Melhor, O/A Maior...
rules: Adjetivos curtos (1-2 sílabas): the + adjetivo + -est → the tallest, the fastest
Adjetivos longos (3+ sílabas): the most + adjetivo → the most beautiful, the most expensive
Dobrar consoante final: big → the biggest | hot → the hottest
y → iest: happy → the happiest | busy → the busiest
Irregulares: good → the best | bad → the worst | far → the furthest

quiz.q: She is ___ student in the class. (intelligent)
This is ___ building in the city. (tall)
That was ___ day of my life. (bad)
He is ___ runner on the team. (fast)

speak: This is the best day ever.
She is the most intelligent person I know.
English is the most useful language.
He is the tallest in the room.
